info.title: Cadmus HTTP API
info.description: REST translation of the Cadmus command protocol. Generated from @cadmus/contract. readOnly commands are GET and HEAD with query parameters; other commands are POST JSON. Authorization is a Bearer header. A token query parameter is rejected.

200.description: Same as GET with an empty body

post.summary: Create a just-bash or local-daemon tools env definition. Daemon rows require confineToWorkspace or confinementPolicy. The workspace path is reported by the daemon process.
Update a tools env definition. Kind is immutable.
Delete a tools env definition and its env DO data.
Mint a 15-minute single-use pairing token for a local-daemon env.

Deregister a tools env. Every kind is removed the same way as delete: env state is wiped, the account row is dropped, and the account default is cleared when it pointed at this env. A local-daemon env first has its pairing revoked and any live connection closed.

ThinkingLevel.description: Budget and intensity level for extended model reasoning / thinking tokens.

content.description: Serialized output or return value produced by the tool.

isError.description: True if the tool execution failed with an error.

durationMs.description: Execution duration in milliseconds, if recorded.

ToolsEnvBinding.description: Binding that names an account tools env by id.

workspacePath.description: Directory reported by the connected daemon. Omitted while disconnected.

confined.description: Effective confinement state of the active connection.

enabled.description: Whether this level turns the tools env on.

anyOf.description: Explicit tools env setting at one level.

ToolsEnvSetting.description: Tools env setting: an explicit on/off value, or null to inherit.

anyOf.description: Plain text content block.

redacted.description: True if the thinking block was redacted by provider safety.

anyOf.description: Extended model reasoning / thinking block.

name.description: Name of the invoked tool.

arguments.description: Arguments object passed to the tool.

anyOf.description: Tool invocation block with optional server-bound result summary.

data.description: Base64 data or URI of the image.

anyOf.description: Image content block.

TranscriptContentBlock.description: Content block within a transcript message.

entryKind.description: Underlying durable entry kind (e.g. pi.user, pi.assistant, pi.toolResult, pi.compaction, pi.system, pi.reset).

visibleToUser.description: Whether this entry belongs to the user-visible continuous stream.

visibleToModel.description: Whether this entry is currently included in the active LLM context.

firstKeptEntryId.description: First entry ID retained verbatim by this compaction entry.

text.description: Rendered plain text content of the message.

replyToEntryId.description: Server-bound entry ID of the user request that this message responds to.

thinking.description: Combined extended reasoning/thinking text, if any.

toolCallId.description: Tool call ID for toolResult messages.

fromBotId.description: Bot that posted this group-chat message. Present on member-attributed group logs.

authorUserId.description: User who authored this user message, as authenticated by the server. Absent for messages written before authorship was recorded and for bot-originated turns.

name.description: Name of the invoked tool.

arguments.description: Arguments object passed to the tool.

anyOf.description: Thinking block produced during model reasoning.

toolName.description: Name of the invoked agent tool.

anyOf.description: Agent tool invocation block.

text.description: Text content of the assistant message chunk.

anyOf.description: Assistant response text block.

TurnBlock.description: Structured turn component block representing reasoning, tool call, or text output.

aborted.description: Always true, confirming the in-progress turn was interrupted and aborted.

chatKey.description: Chat session routing key where the turn was aborted.

TurnInterruptResult.description: Result payload returned by turn.interrupt or turn.abort confirming cancellation.

conversationId.description: Internal durable conversation sequence ID backing this chat.

entryId.description: Transcript entry sequence number assigned to this completed turn.

blocks.description: Structured content blocks (thinking, tool calls, text) produced during the turn.

TurnSettledResult.description: Result payload returned upon synchronous completion of a model turn.

cacheWrite1h.description: Tokens written to 1-hour cache if supported.

cacheRead.description: Cache read token cost in USD.

cacheWrite.description: Cache write token cost in USD.

UsageSources.description: Token usage and costs broken down by execution source.

tools.description: Token usage directly attributed to tool executions.

UsageSummary.description: Aggregated usage metrics with multi-dimensional breakdowns.
